name: Astral Vanguard
description: Front-line conquerors who believe every floor exists to be cleared first. No ceremony, no hierarchy, just whoever is still climbing.
oath: You sign the climb board. First up the stair leads. The rest follow the chalk.

name: Shadow Covenant
description: A quiet, calculating guild that trusts results over reputation. They let their floor counts speak for them.
oath: You give your name and nothing else. They will read the floors, not the speech.

name: Gilded Order
description: Disciplined and prestige-driven. Every member treats a conquered floor like a badge of honor.
oath: You take the oath standing. A floor is a badge. The board outside is work, not glory.

name: Stormbreakers
description: Reckless, loud, and always first through the dungeon gate. Leadership goes to whoever dives deepest.
oath: They shout your name once and point at the gate. Deepest dive leads. Try not to die famous.

name: Emberwake
description: Bound by rivalry and fire. Every member is chasing the next floor record, and the guild answers to whoever is winning.
oath: The hearth takes your name. Whoever is winning the floors answers for the rest.
